author: product-requirements-expert
context: Triage of the visit-cancellation slice. The request asks to add a cancel action beside each upcoming visit on the owner detail page, removing the visit from the pet's record. This collides head-on with two confirmed boundaries: NG-5 (changing or cancelling a visit once booked) and NG-4 (deleting a visit). Both were confirmed deliberate on 2026-08-08 and are backed by adr/2026-08-08-non-goal-deletion-and-visit-amendment.md, which decided a booked visit is immutable and the sample deletes nothing. That ADR sets an explicit gate: 'A future request touching either row proceeds only on an explicit owner decision recorded at intake. The request itself never reopens the row.' The dispatch I received carries no such recorded owner decision — it reads as a fresh feature ask unaware of the non-goals.
question: Do you (the owner) explicitly decide to reverse or narrow NG-5 (and NG-4 as it applies to visits) to permit visit cancellation? Per the ADR the request alone cannot reopen the row. If yes, that decision must be recorded at intake and I will (a) author a new non-goal ADR narrowing NG-4/NG-5, (b) update the Non-Goals table and preamble, and (c) author REQ-VISITCANCEL-001 with acceptance criteria and any residual non-goals. If no, this slice is out of scope and I will not author the requirement. Please also confirm the intended meaning of 'upcoming visit' (visit date strictly later than today) and whether cancellation should hard-delete the visit record or mark it cancelled while retaining history.
stop_state: Boundary check complete; no prd-entry authored. Awaiting recorded owner decision on NG-4/NG-5 before scoping.
